module "P_UniformKinds.dss"

product 0 Material "M_UniformKinds" backend=Graph
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L21:C17 "UV"
  %1 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 1), ParameterName="Tiling", SortPriority=1) : float4 @L5:C1 "Tiling"
  %2 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="xy") : float2 @L5:C1 "UV"
  %3 = Multiply(%0, %2) : float2 @L21:C17 "UV"
  %4 = TextureParameter(ParameterName="NormalMap", SamplerType="Normal", SortPriority=7) : Texture2D @L15:C1 "NormalMap"
  %5 = TextureSample(%4, %3, _, _, SamplerType="Normal") : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L22:C16 "Normal"
  %6 = Swizzle(%5, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L22:C16 "Normal"
  %7 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 0, 0), ParameterName="Colour", SortPriority=2) : float4 @L6:C1 "Colour"
  %8 = Swizzle(%7, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L6:C1 "EmissiveColor"
  %9 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 1, 1, 1), ParameterName="Tint", SortPriority=3) : float4 @L7:C1 "Tint"
  %10 = Swizzle(%9, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L23:C32 "EmissiveColor"
  %11 = Multiply(%8, %10) : float3 @L23:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %12 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.7), Description="The overall gain", Group="Look", ParameterName="Gain", SliderMax=4, SliderMin=0, SortPriority=20) : float @L4:C1 "Gain"
  %13 = Multiply(%11, %12) : float3 @L23:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %14 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L17:C1 "EmissiveColor"
  %15 = Multiply(%13, %14) : float3 @L23:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %16 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0), ParameterName="Invert", SortPriority=5) : float @L9:C1 "Invert"
  %17 = Constant(Value=(1)) : float @L24:C26 "Opacity"
  %18 = Subtract(%17, %12) : float @L24:C26 "Opacity"
  %19 = Select(%16, %18, %12) : float @L24:C17 "Opacity"
  %20 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0), ParameterName="Channel", SortPriority=4) : float @L8:C1 "Channel"
  %21 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1), IsStatic=true, ParameterName="UseColour", SortPriority=6) : bool @L12:C1 "UseColour"
  %22 = StaticSwitch(%21, %8, %10) : float3 @L26:C19 "BaseColor"
  %23 = MaterialSink(Normal=%6, EmissiveColor=%15, Opacity=%19, Roughness=%20, BaseColor=%22) @L19:C1
  sink %23
